scheme_name: Deendayal Upadhyaya Sahakarita Kisan Kalyan Yojana
description: Provides interest-free loans to small, marginal, and hill farmers to purchase agri-inputs, farm machinery, and establish allied agricultural enterprises like dairy, poultry, and horticulture.
benefits: Interest-free crop and agri-loans up to ₹3,00,000 for individual farmers and up to ₹5,00,000 for Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) and Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
eligibility: Small, marginal, and hill farmers residing in Uttarakhand
Must be members of Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS) or cooperative banks in Uttarakhand
application_mode: Offline via District Cooperative Bank Branches / PACS / Local Agriculture Extension Officer

scheme_name: Uttarakhand Apple Mission & High-Density Plantation Scheme
description: Promotes high-density apple orchards using imported clonal rootstocks to modernize hill horticulture and significantly increase fruit productivity per unit area.
benefits: Up to 80% capital subsidy on purchasing high-density apple saplings, anti-hail nets, drip irrigation systems, and trellis support structures.
eligibility: Farmers owning land in hill districts of Uttarakhand located at suitable altitudes for apple cultivation (above 5,000 feet)
documents: Altitude Verification / Land Suitability Certificate from Horticulture Dept
application_mode: Online via Uttarakhand Horticulture Portal / Offline through Chief Horticulture Officer (CHO)

scheme_name: Chief Minister State Aromatic Plant Mission (Aroma Valley Scheme)
description: Encourages cultivation of wild-animal-resistant aromatic plants (Damask Rose, Lemongrass, Cinnamon, Lavender, Mint) to prevent crop damage by wildlife and utilize abandoned hill terraces.
benefits: Free supply of high-yielding aromatic planting material, 50% subsidy on installing essential oil distillation units, and guaranteed buyback through CAP (Centre for Aromatic Plants).
eligibility: Farmers, landholders, and cluster groups in hill districts of Uttarakhand
application_mode: Offline via Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP), Selaqui, Dehradun / District Horticulture Office

description: Supports construction of modern naturally ventilated polyhouses across hill blocks for off-season vegetable cultivation and floriculture to boost hill farm incomes.
benefits: 80% capital subsidy for installing polyhouse structures up to 100 sq. meters to 500 sq. meters, along with subsidised high-yielding vegetable seeds and drip kits.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers residing in Uttarakhand holding suitable terraced agricultural land
application_mode: Online via Uttarakhand Horticulture Portal (shm.uk.gov.in) / District Horticulture Office

scheme_name: Uttarakhand Climate Responsive Rainfed Farming Project (UDRP - Climate Smart Agriculture)
description: A World Bank-assisted project focusing on soil moisture conservation, water harvesting ponds, spring-shed rejuvenation, and drought-tolerant seed adoption across rainfed hill watersheds.
benefits: Grants for constructing plastic-lined farm ponds (poly-tanks), bench terracing, soil health restoration, and distribution of climate-resilient millet/pulse minikits.
eligibility: Farmers residing in selected micro-watershed development blocks across Uttarakhand hill districts
application_mode: Offline via Watershed Management Directorate (WMD) / Gram Panchayat Development Officer

scheme_name: Millet Mission Uttarakhand (House Crowning / House-Hold Millet Scheme)
description: Promotes production, processing, and procurement of indigenous hill millets (Mandua / Finger Millet, Jhangora / Barnyard Millet) at Guaranteed Minimum Support Prices.
benefits: Direct cash incentive of ₹1,500 per acre for millet cultivators, guaranteed government procurement at remunerative prices, and free certified millet seeds.
eligibility: Farmers cultivating indigenous millets in designated hill blocks of Uttarakhand
application_mode: Online via Agri Portal / Offline through Local Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO)

scheme_name: Chief Minister Solar Pump Scheme (PM-KUSUM Uttarakhand)
description: Installs solar water pumpsets (2 HP to 7.5 HP) on hill terraces and valley lands where electricity grid lines are difficult to extend.
benefits: Up to 80% to 90% combined Central and State financial subsidy on standalone solar water pumping systems.
eligibility: Farmers owning land in Uttarakhand with access to surface water streams, wells, or ponds without grid power
documents: Self-Declaration of No Existing Electric Connection
application_mode: Online via UREDA Portal (ureda.uk.gov.in) / District Agriculture Officer

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Anchal Amrit Yojana & Dairy Development Scheme
description: Promotes high-yielding dairy cattle rearing, milk co-operatives formation, modern cattle sheds, and chaff cutters across hill and plain districts.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy on purchasing crossbred cows/badri cows, 75% subsidy on chaff cutters, and ₹4 per liter bonus on milk supplied to dairy cooperatives.
eligibility: Dairy farmers and members of Anchal Dairy Cooperative Societies in Uttarakhand
application_mode: Offline via Local Dairy Development Officer / Anchal Milk Union Centre

scheme_name: Uttarakhand Cold-Water Fisheries & Trout Racing Mission
description: Utilizes perennial mountain streams to construct concrete raceways for commercial culture of high-value Rainbow Trout fish.
benefits: 60% subsidy for SC/ST/Women and 40% for General beneficiaries on raceway construction, trout feed, and disease-free trout seed.
eligibility: Individual landholders and fishermen in hill districts with perennial cold-water stream access
application_mode: Offline via District Fisheries Officer (DFO) / Directorate of Fisheries, Dehradun

scheme_name: Hill Farm Machinery & Power Tiller Subsidy Scheme (SMAM Uttarakhand)
description: Subsidizes specialized light-weight agricultural machinery designed for narrow mountain terraces, including power tillers, brush cutters, weeders, and mini-threshers.
benefits: 50% to 80% subsidy on hill-friendly farm equipment for individual farmers and up to 80% for Custom Hiring Centers operated by SHGs/Cooperatives.
eligibility: Farmers owning land in Uttarakhand hill districts registered on the Agmachinery portal
application_mode: Online via Agmachinery Portal / District Agriculture Office
